딸기.x: The strawberries are very sweet and tasty.
딸기.e: 딸기 우유 (strawberry milk) is a favorite Korean convenience-store drink.

출구.x: Let's meet in front of exit 3 of the subway station.
출구.e: Literally 'go-out mouth'; -구 = opening: 출구, 입구, 비상구.

배탈이 나다.forms: 배탈이 났어요 (I have an upset stomach) · 배탈이 날 것 같아요 (I think my stomach will act up)
배탈이 나다.ex: 길에서 산 음식을 먹고 배탈이 났어요.
배탈이 나다.x: I ate food I bought on the street and got an upset stomach.
배탈이 나다.t: Use the past tense for how you feel now: 배탈이 났어요 means you have an upset stomach.

게으르다.x: I get a little lazy when the weekend comes.

찌개.ex: 오늘 저녁에는 맛있는 찌개를 끓일 거예요.
찌개.x: I'm going to make a delicious stew for dinner tonight.
찌개.e: Thicker and saltier than 국 'soup'; often shared from one pot at the table.
찌개.t: Use 끓이다, not 만들다, for making stew: 찌개를 끓여요.

감사하다.ex: 항상 저를 도와주셔서 선생님께 정말 감사하다고 말씀드렸어요.
감사하다.x: I told my teacher I was really grateful to her for always helping me.
감사하다.t: 감사합니다 and 고맙습니다 mean the same; 감사합니다 sounds slightly more formal and is safest with strangers.

안부.ex: 집에 돌아가시면 부모님께 안부 꼭 전해 주세요.
안부.x: When you get home, please be sure to give my regards to your parents.
안부.e: Literally 'safe or not' — asking whether someone is doing well.
안부.t: Set phrases: 안부를 묻다 (ask how someone is) and 안부를 전하다 (send regards).

삼촌.m: uncle (father's younger, unmarried brother; casually any uncle)
삼촌.ex: 삼촌이 생일 선물로 자전거를 사 주셨어요.
삼촌.x: My uncle bought me a bicycle for my birthday.
삼촌.e: Literally 'three degrees' of kinship; -촌 counts family distance: 사촌 = four degrees.
삼촌.t: Strictly 삼촌 is a father's brother; a mother's brother is 외삼촌, though kids often just say 삼촌.

모든.forms: 모든 + noun: 모든 사람 · 모든 것
모든.ex: 우리 반 모든 학생이 시험에 합격했어요.
모든.x: Every student in our class passed the exam.
모든.t: 모든 must come before a noun; on their own use 모두 or 다: 모두 왔어요.

자꾸.forms: 자꾸 + verb = keep (doing); 자꾸자꾸 = over and over
자꾸.x: Lately, for some reason, I keep getting headaches.
자꾸.e: Doubled as 자꾸자꾸 for 'over and over'.

거래.ex: 우리는 그 회사와 10년 동안 거래를 했어요.
거래.x: We did business with that company for ten years.
거래.e: Literally 'going and coming' — goods and money moving back and forth.
거래.t: 거래처 means a business client or partner company.

세배.x: On Lunar New Year's morning, I gave my grandmother a New Year's bow.
세배.e: Literally 'year bow'; afterward children receive 세뱃돈, New Year's money.
세배.t: You 세배를 드리다 to elders while saying 새해 복 많이 받으세요.

원인.ex: 경찰은 아직 사고 원인을 찾지 못했어요.
원인.x: The police haven't found the cause of the accident yet.
원인.t: 원인 is the cause of an event; 이유 is a person's reason for doing something.

금지.x: Taking photos is prohibited inside the museum.
금지.t: Signs often use it as a suffix: 주차 금지 (no parking), 출입 금지 (no entry).

주의하다.m: to be careful, to pay attention, to watch out
주의하다.x: Take care of your health so you don't catch a cold.
주의하다.t: Takes 에: 건강에 주의하다, 차에 주의하다 — slightly more formal than 조심하다.

발달.x: Thanks to the development of the internet, life has become much easier.
발달.e: Literally 'set out and reach' a higher stage.
발달.t: Pronounced [발딸]; 발달 is natural growth (body, technology), while 발전 stresses progress toward a better state.

인연.m: fate, destiny (bringing people together); connection, tie
인연.x: It must be fate that we met here.
인연.e: A Buddhist idea: causes and bonds that bring people together.
인연.t: Pronounced [이년]; 인연이 아니다 is a gentle way to say 'it wasn't meant to be'.

살펴보다.m: to look over, to examine, to check carefully
살펴보다.x: Look over the contract carefully, then sign it.
살펴보다.e: 살피다 'to observe' + 보다 'to look': to look carefully.

포함하다.ex: 저를 포함해서 모두 다섯 명이 왔어요.
포함하다.x: Five people came in total, including me.

허가.x: You need permission to take pictures here.
허가.t: 허가 is official permission from an authority; for permission from parents or friends, use 허락.

진실.x: He finally told people the truth.
진실.t: 진실 is the truth versus lies; 사실 is a plain fact.

바삭바삭.x: The tempura came out nice and crispy.
바삭바삭.e: Sound word (의성어) for biting dry, crisp food. Dark-vowel 버석버석 is the coarser, drier sound, like stepping on dry leaves.
바삭바삭.t: Pronounced [바삭빠삭]: the final ㄱ makes the next ㅂ tense. 바삭하다 is everyday: 바삭한 치킨 'crispy chicken'.

따님.x: Your daughter looks a lot like you, ma'am.
따님.e: 딸 + honorific -님; the ㄹ drops before ㄴ.
따님.t: Never use it for your own daughter; say 딸.

연수.ex: 신입 사원들은 한 달 동안 연수를 받아요.
연수.x: New employees receive training for a month.
연수.e: Literally 'study and cultivate' — training to polish your skills.
연수.t: 어학연수 is a very common word: going abroad for language study.

하교.m: leaving school (for the day), going home from school
하교.ex: 하교 시간이 되면 학교 앞이 복잡해져요.
하교.x: When school lets out, the area in front of the school gets crowded.

대중음악.ex: 한국 대중음악은 전 세계에서 인기가 많아요.
대중음악.x: Korean pop music is very popular around the world.

아날로그.e: From English 'analog'; 아날로그 감성 means a cozy, retro, low-tech vibe.

궤도.x: The satellite is orbiting the Earth.
궤도.t: 궤도에 오르다 also means 'to get on track', e.g. a business finally running smoothly.

산만하다.x: The child is very distracted in class.

마저.forms: 마저 + verb (마저 먹다/하다) = finish the rest
마저.m: (finishing) the rest, completely, all the way
마저.x: I'll finish the rest of my rice and then go out.
마저.t: As an adverb it means 'finish off the rest'; as a particle (너마저) it means 'even you'.

선출하다.x: The students elected a new president by vote.
선출하다.e: Literally 'choose and put forward' — choosing a person by vote.
선출하다.t: 선출하다 is for people chosen by vote; use 선정하다 for things like books, sites or winners.

제외하다.m: to exclude, to leave out, to except
제외하다.x: I work out every morning except on weekends.
제외하다.t: N을 제외하고 (= except N) is the most common pattern.

한눈을 팔다.forms: 한눈을 팔아요 · 한눈을 팔았어요 · 한눈파는 사이에 (ㄹ drops)
한눈을 팔다.m: to look away, to get distracted, to not pay attention
한눈을 팔다.x: It's dangerous to look away while driving.
한눈을 팔다.e: 한눈 = a glance aside; 팔다 here means 'to let one's attention wander.'
한눈을 팔다.t: Don't confuse 한눈을 팔다 with 한눈에 'at a glance.'

도매.e: Literally 'sell all together': selling in bulk.

배낭여행.x: When I was in college, I went backpacking in Europe.
배낭여행.t: Pronounced [배낭녀행] — an ㄴ sound is inserted before 여.

재혼.x: My mother remarried after my father passed away.

담화.x: The president delivered an address to the nation today.
담화.t: 대국민 담화 is a president's or leader's address to the nation, a staple of Korean news.

추론하다.m: to infer, to deduce, to reason
추론하다.x: I deduced who the culprit was from the remaining evidence.
추론하다.e: Literally 'push an argument forward' to a conclusion.
추론하다.t: 추론하다 is reasoning from evidence; 추측하다 is a looser guess.

설비.ex: 공장은 낡은 설비를 최신 장비로 바꿨습니다.
설비.x: The factory replaced its old equipment with the latest machinery.

분산하다.m: to disperse, to spread out, to diversify
분산하다.ex: 위험을 줄이려면 투자를 분산하는 게 좋아요.
분산하다.x: To reduce risk, it's good to diversify your investments.

모면하다.m: to escape, to get out of (a bad situation), to narrowly avoid
모면하다.x: He barely got out of the crisis by lying.
모면하다.e: Literally 'scheme to escape' — wriggling out of trouble.

불가사의하다.ex: 그 사건은 지금까지도 불가사의하게 남아 있어요.
불가사의하다.x: That incident remains a mystery even now.
불가사의하다.e: Literally 'cannot be thought or discussed' — originally a Buddhist term.
불가사의하다.t: 세계 7대 불가사의 means 'the Seven Wonders of the World'.

죄다.m: all, every single one, without exception
죄다.ex: 친구들이 죄다 그 드라마 얘기만 해요.
죄다.x: All my friends talk about nothing but that drama.
죄다.e: Homonym warning: the verb 죄다 means 'to tighten' (= 조이다).
죄다.t: Casual spoken word; in formal writing use 모두 or 전부 instead.

꼬박꼬박.ex: 저는 월세를 한 번도 안 밀리고 꼬박꼬박 내요.
꼬박꼬박.x: I pay my rent faithfully without ever being late.
꼬박꼬박.e: Doubled 꼬박: every single time, none skipped.

결의.ex: 선수들은 이번에는 꼭 이기겠다는 결의를 다졌어요.
결의.x: The players strengthened their resolve to win this time no matter what.
결의.e: Literally 'decided intention'; the homonym 결의 meaning a group's formal resolution uses a different second syllable.
결의.t: Pronounced [겨릐/겨리]; 결의를 다지다 (firm up one's resolve) is the key collocation.

부채비율.ex: 그 회사는 부채비율이 너무 높아서 대출을 받기 어려워요.
부채비율.x: That company's debt ratio is so high it's hard for it to get a loan.
부채비율.t: The suffix for 'rate' is written 율 after a vowel or ㄴ (비율, 환율) and 률 elsewhere (성장률).

잠재성장률.ex: 인구 감소로 한국의 잠재성장률이 계속 낮아지고 있어요.
잠재성장률.x: Korea's potential growth rate keeps falling because of population decline.
잠재성장률.e: Literally 'hidden growth rate': how fast an economy could grow without causing inflation.
잠재성장률.t: Pronounced [잠재성장뉼]: ㄹ after ㅇ becomes ㄴ.

감세.ex: 정부는 내년부터 중소기업에 대한 감세를 추진할 계획입니다.
감세.x: The government plans to push for tax cuts for small and midsize businesses starting next year.
감세.t: 감세 정책 'tax-cut policy' is a common news collocation; the opposite is 증세 'tax hike.'

노동시장.ex: 청년들의 노동시장 진입이 점점 어려워지고 있습니다.
노동시장.x: Entering the labor market is getting harder and harder for young people.

유예.x: The government postponed implementing the new system for one year.
유예.e: Literally 'hesitating' — holding off on action for a set period.
유예.t: Common pairs: 집행유예 (suspended sentence), 입영 유예 (military deferment), 유예 기간 (grace period).

침술.ex: 침술은 한국 전통 의학의 중요한 치료법이에요.
침술.x: Acupuncture is an important treatment in traditional Korean medicine.

여과.ex: 이 물은 여과 과정을 거쳐서 마셔도 안전해요.
여과.x: This water has gone through filtration, so it's safe to drink.
여과.t: 여과 없이 means 'unfiltered' and is also used for uncensored media content.

소행성.ex: 큰 소행성이 지구 가까이 지나갈 예정이라고 합니다.
소행성.x: They say a large asteroid will pass close to Earth.
소행성.e: Literally 'small planet'; 행성 is 'moving star,' i.e. planet.

비엔날레.ex: 광주 비엔날레는 2년마다 열리는 국제 미술 전시예요.
비엔날레.x: The Gwangju Biennale is an international art exhibition held every two years.
비엔날레.t: Pronounced [비엔날레]; Korea's best-known is the Gwangju Biennale, started in 1995.

아연하다.ex: 뜻밖의 소식에 모두 아연한 표정을 지었어요.
아연하다.x: Everyone looked dumbfounded at the unexpected news.
아연하다.t: Usually in 아연실색하다 'to turn pale with shock'; the homonym 아연 means 'zinc'.

사사건건.m: in every single matter, at every turn
사사건건.x: My younger sibling meddles in every little thing I do.
사사건건.t: Pronounced [사사껀껀]; almost always negative, with meddling or opposing.

외연.ex: 복지 정책의 외연이 점점 넓어지고 있습니다.
외연.x: The scope of welfare policy is gradually widening.
외연.e: Literally 'outward extension'; the counterpart of 내포.
외연.t: Collocation: 외연을 넓히다/확장하다 'to broaden the scope'.

편린.m: glimpse, fragment, small part (of a larger whole)
편린.ex: 이 편지에서 그의 성격의 편린을 엿볼 수 있어요.
편린.x: In this letter, you can catch a glimpse of his character.
편린.e: Literally 'a single fish scale' that hints at the whole creature.
편린.t: Pronounced [펼린]; usually in 편린을 엿보다, 'to catch a glimpse of.'

수구초심.x: The older I get, the more I long for my hometown.
수구초심.e: A dying fox turns its head toward the hill where its den was.
